title: Mastering Wealth
paragraphs: Every human being is born to be a leader. Most of them will die as followers. This is because no one ever told them how to become that leader. I want to start with a statement. Here is a picture of some sheep. Sheep are the stupidest animals on earth. They are the only animals on Earth that do not have a leader. If you study a flock of sheep, you will never see a leader. There is no such thing as a leader sheep. That's why sheep are stupid. It only follows what is in front of it.

That is why they fall from cliffs, into rivers, and off mountains. That is why they are the only animals that God created that need a shepherd. Every other animal does not need a human. As for sheep, they need... Sheep are stupid. If someone calls you a sheep, it's not a compliment. Some of you are wondering why God says that you are like sheep. This is not flattery. God says: “ You are all like sheep that have lost their way. You are lost. You do not know where you are going.”

He says: "You have strayed from my laws and principles. You are wandering like sheep." He said, "But I came as a shepherd to guide you to where you have fallen, not to keep you as sheep." Because sheep are always stupid. God does not want you to be stupid. Here is a phrase I want you to think about. An army of sheep led by a lion will always defeat an army of lions if it is led by a sheep. Let me say it again. An army of sheep led by a lion will always defeat an army of lions if it is led by a sheep.

What does this proverb mean? It means that leadership dictates everything. In other words, leadership determines the quality of followers. Leadership also determines the mindset of the followers. Leadership determines the morals of the followers. Leadership also determines the behavior of followers. Leadership determines the commitment of followers. Leadership determines the fate of the followers. You can't be better than your leader. If your leader stops growing, you will stop growing.

If your leader stops expanding, the organization will stop expanding. You cannot overstep the boundaries set by your leader. Jesus said these words. If a blind man leads, listen to his words. I am quoting Jesus. If the blind lead, the followers must also be blind. If a blind man leads a blind man, both will fall into a pit. He is talking about your destiny. It tells us first that you can be in a leadership position and still be blind. You can have a title, a position, power, and authority, and yet be blind.

Never let people in high positions convince you. This does not mean that they know where they are going. Some of you are wondering about the world leaders today. I work with them personally. I am talking about heads of state, I sit with them in closed rooms and I am shocked by their ignorance. They are blind, and we rely on them to lead our countries, societies, institutions, and economies. Jesus said, "Wherever they go, you will go too." They both fall into the hole.

Therefore, it is important for you to question your leaders. Do not ask your leader whether he has power, authority, money, or status. Ask him: "Do you have a vision? Where are you going? Why should I follow you? What is the destination?" Some of you are so emotional that you forget to be rational. We are excited about people who perform miracles and have no destination. We are excited about good preachers who have no agenda.

We get excited about people who do miraculous things but have no destiny, and they lead you into an emotional pit. Leadership is the most important activity on earth because it determines the fate of followers. That's why I focus so much on leadership. The leadership is strong. Write this down. Leaders provide confidence to fearful people. Leadership provides certainty where people hesitate. Leaders also provide work where people are reluctant.

Do you know that when the children of Israel reached the Sea of ​​Reeds, they began to become depressed? Everyone was scared, then a leader emerged. Moses stood on a rock and ended his hesitation. He said, " I promise you today that the people coming after us will be dead by sunset." He took action. Then he ran behind the bushes and said to God, "Did you hear what I said to them?" Leaders usually announce things they cannot do. Write that down. True leaders always speak in a way that makes them dependent on God.

It is important for you to do that. Announce the things, and God will make them happen. Don't wait until it's implemented. Put pressure on God. Number four, leaders give strength where there is weakness. They provide expertise where there is confusion. Leaders give courage where people are cowards. They urge people to believe. As Moses said to the people: “Stand firm and be strong. Every one of Pharaoh’s army will be killed tomorrow.” He gave them courage. Leaders also provide optimism where there is pessimism.

Leaders provide the conviction that the future is possible. Brother Tom came to me a few moments ago this morning and said, "You know, we still have a budget to meet at this conference." I am not surprised that he said that, as most leaders do not have the money. They have the vision. They rely on God to meet the needs in this process. That is why God brought you here. He, this man, is convinced and believes that this meeting is possible. So the hotel was booked completely before people even registered.

That is conviction. The hotel signed an agreement with Tom and said: " For every unoccupied room, you will have to pay for it." He signed it. Hoping that you will come. That is leadership. We should all act this way. This is called faith. Faith means believing in something you cannot yet see. And to be so convinced of it that you actually take the initiative. Number nine, leaders create commitment in others to pursue strategy and success.

In other words, a leader, male or female, can motivate people to commit to a future that has not yet come and encourage them to devote their energy to a particular strategy and program. This is leadership. I influence more than 15,000 leaders worldwide within our network, and it is growing every day. Millions of people look to me for guidance. Therefore, I stay close to God because I need to give guidance, because I must give them a strategy, a program to create the future. Write this down.

Leaders shape the future. I want you to think about the reason you were born. I was born to change the world. The current state of the world is not what God wants. He doesn't want you to complain. He wants you to obey his will. He doesn't want you to be depressed. He wants you to sit down and design the future of your community. So remember this: the leader ultimately gives hope and faith. Hope is giving people a reason to believe in temporary things. Everything you are going through is temporary.

And the leader makes you believe that. What you are going through now is not permanent. You are on your way to a better place. This is leadership. I came to you this morning to tell you that 2014 will be a better year for you. If you believe that, applaud and praise God. This is faith. This is faith. There are two animals on Earth that God likened himself to. In fact, they are the only two he identified and stated. The first is the lion. The second is the eagle. These are two important animals.

And why did God compare himself to them? Firstly, because He is the one who created them. Secondly, because he knows that he has instilled in them leadership qualities similar to his own. Therefore, God identifies with leadership. The lion is the king of the animal kingdom. The eagle is the king of the bird kingdom. They are both leaders. God says: "I am like an eagle and I will carry you on my wings. I will move your nest as an eagle moves its nest. I will carry you on my feathers. I am like an eagle."

Then God says: "I am like a lion. " In fact, my son Jesus Christ is not Judas's dog. Not the bird of Judah. What is it? He is the Lion of Judah. Look, it's the Lion of Judah. Jesus says: "I am like a lion." I want to talk about Assad for a moment, because Assad is the embodiment of the contradictions of leadership. I learned from the lion who I am today. Firstly, the lion is not the tallest animal in the jungle. The lion is not the strongest animal in the jungle. Not the most capable.

It is not the most intelligent animal. However, the lion is the leader. Tell your neighbors that there is hope for you. The lion cancels all your excuses for not being a leader. The lion negates the belief that you need to be strong, smart, big, tall, or influential. It cancels all of that. Most forest animals are larger than a lion, more capable, stronger, and more intelligent. However, when the lion appears, everyone becomes nervous. Clearly, the lion is teaching us that strength does not make you a leader.

Ability does not make you a leader. Intelligence does not make you a leader. So the question is: what makes a lion a leader? From my research, I discovered one simple word: attitude. Write it down so everyone can say: The situation. The situation. Say it out loud. Say it louder. The situation. You are exactly who you are because of your mindset. So the question is, what is the mentality and where does it come from? The answer in one word: belief. Mentality is a product of belief.

Everything you believe in shapes your mindset. If you are shy, scared, depressed, or sad, if you are nervous or afraid to move forward, it is because of your belief system. The lion possesses a belief system that makes him a leader. He believes he can prey on an elephant. An elephant is 180 times larger than a lion. It is 800 pounds heavier than him. It is 190% more intelligent than a lion. An elephant is heavier than a lion. It is taller than a lion. He is stronger than a lion. However, the lion doesn't care. Why?

Because of his belief system. Belief produces a third thing, which is confidence. When a person is confident, it is because of their belief system. They believe in their ability to accomplish their tasks. That's why Moses had so much confidence. He believed what God had told him in the bush, in the burning bush. He believed that. So when he saw the power of Egypt, the greatest civilization on earth at that time, Moses was not afraid. He said to Pharaoh, "I have come to tell you, release my people."

Where did he get this confidence from? Out of his faith. Where did he get his faith from? From God. And that's how his mindset made him a leader. In other words, you are exactly what you believe. Do you see this picture? I picked it up myself. I travel to Africa at least four times a year. One of my favorite places to go is the animal sanctuary. I go to visit my relatives. My best friends are lions. That's why I love Jesus.

I love watching them because they teach me how to run his companies, how to be a good shepherd, how to make money, how to develop people, and how to train young people. The lion teaches me all of that. They are teaching me how to advise governments, and how to be a good advisor. Look at this lion. The elephant is right next to him. He refuses to move. Actually, look into his eyes. I wonder what he's thinking. I discovered what he was thinking. The elephant is a powerful tractor.

A monster, strength, toughness, weight, and intelligence. The lion looks at all that strength, toughness, and might and thinks of one word, a simple word. Clap your hands now. This is how a lion thinks. The lion simply says, "Here is lunch." Now, imagine what the lion is doing here. He reduces the elephant to just a meal in his mind. This is what leaders do. They are looking at the problem. They look up to the challenge. They look at the obstacle and the leader thinks: We can handle this. We can do that.

We can achieve this. They reduce everything to a meal. God thought this way. God wanted to save the whole world with all its problems, sins, depression, darkness, diseases, and ailments. God said, "Let's fix things." He did not send ten thousand people, but only one. Jesus, just like the lion, looked at the problem of the world and simply said: "For God so loved the world that he sent me." "What?" Yes, it's just me. Why? This is lunch. Then he says: "As the Father has sent me, so I send you."

Your country is a Muslim country. A Hindu country. An atheist country. An unbelieving country. God says, "Go back to your country and have lunch." Clap. You have the power to change your entire country. Amen. If I tell you my story, some of you may have seen pictures of me receiving the Congolese Medal of Honor from the government of Peru. I have received awards from more than 80 countries, I visit nations, and I influence entire countries. I was in Swaziland just last week.

I was in Botswana, sitting with the King of Swaziland. He completely changed his country through one meeting with me. He made a public announcement. I gave him advice that changed the way he governed. Can you change countries? Yes. It's lunchtime. Stop thinking so small about yourself. You are a leader. Say it out loud. I am a leader. Say it again. I am a leader. Do not return home hoping that things will change. Make things change. Start from where you are. Because the world is collapsing.

And in this first session, I want to talk a little about the world. This is the elephant you are facing. I call them global challenges. And I want you to think about it quickly. Our world is in trouble. We are in the middle of wars right now in the place where you are. In the south is Egypt, and the people are in the streets. In the north is Syria, and the people are in the streets. In the East, there is tension, and refugees are everywhere.

To the west lies the Mediterranean Sea, opposite Europe, where unemployment reaches 40%. Our world is dying. My friends from Brazil will tell you about the tension there, where people argue about whether sports are more important than jobs. The world is in trouble and your country is no exception. Whether you are from Malaysia, Africa or America, your country is in trouble. Let's talk about what's happening. First, we have what we call globalization. Globalization is the biggest problem on Earth.

It simply means that what happens in other countries will affect your country. Globalization is a destruction of independence and sovereignty. No country is sovereign anymore. That's why what happens in Washington affects you. What happens in Beijing affects you. What happens in France affects you. What happens in the Middle East affects you. I was talking to my driver when I arrived here at 2 a. m. yesterday, and the driver said that gasoline in Israel costs $8 per gallon.

He told me: I drive for money, not for life. He said that because of the war, the price of oil is affecting everyone. It's globalization. This means that globalization is the interconnection of nations. This represents a huge problem. We who believe in God, and believe in Jesus Christ as our King, especially those who are supposed to be in the Kingdom of God, should not be affected by this. The Bible says: " Be in the world, but not of its order." Don't miss tonight's meeting.

I will talk to you about this because it is important for you to know that the Kingdom of God is present now. I live in it every day. I bought my plane in the midst of the crisis. Why? Because I live in a different country. It is called the Kingdom of Heaven. And the day will come to you. That day will come to you. That day will come to you. I believe that God does not want you to be victims of these systems. You must be in the world, but not from the world. Am I right? Yes.

Therefore, the biggest crisis on Earth is globalization. I want you to write this down. The world is full of fear and people are afraid of crises. But here's the good news. Done it. If you don't solve it, they will go to another preacher. Let me see if you can solve it. People are changing churches because you stopped solving their problems. He said: "I traveled 24 hours to get here from my country." Because God knew that you were about to collapse because of the crisis. You are about to miss the biggest opportunity in your country. Go back to your home and start a business. Amen. You are not a sheep. You are a lion. Go look for elephants, not grass. Go ahead, clap here. Write this down. So the secret, the keys to success in crises, are the crisis itself. Jesus had 5,000 people with him north from here in Galilee.

In other words, this is a great opportunity to prove something. Peter says, "Teacher, we can feed them." Which means they were not bankrupt. Some of you believe that Jesus was poor. Every businessman or businesswoman started their business from something that was in their hands. It was called an idea. Write it down. Write it down. an idea. You always have ideas. He said: Greed, malice, deceit, debauchery, envy, slander, pride, and stupidity. Where do all these evils come from? From within the human heart. Greed.

The number one problem on Earth today is greed. Poverty does not exist on Earth. It does n't exist. Greed is what creates poverty. In fact, look at Luke 12:15. Jesus said, “ Look.” Beware. Be wary of what? From all kinds of greed. You, the people, must study greed, you priests, and preach about it for a year. Notice that he says: "All kinds of greed?" There are many different kinds of greed. There are thousands of ways to be greedy. He says that greed is the cause of poverty.
